subject: Demo Update
author: Psykoboy2
body: Looks like they are going to be adding more content to the demo as the release date gets closer. Already if you go into the pause menu and look at the challenges, they show challenges for 5, 6, 7, & 8 players. All of the challenges are within the demo's map area.
